# EXC016: accept-on-unresolved

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | EXC |
| product | frob |
| severity (default) | error |
| tier | universal |
| scope | repo |
| fix | manual |
| polarity | P+ |
| must_measure | false |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

An accept directive names a rule at a site where the finding is Unresolved.

An Unresolved finding means the tool could not examine the site. Accepting
it would silence the failure without supplying the declaration that fixes
it, so the accept does not suppress it and the finding stands. Park it with
`frob:defer` and a ticket, or put it in a baseline.

## Examples

### EXC016 accept over an Unresolved finding / Fires when an accept names a rule whose finding is Unresolved #1 (line 6) (fire)

```rust
/* frob:accept DOC001 because="the broken item below is generated elsewhere" */ // error: EXC016
pub fn f( {
```
